_comment: Per-user standing sender->folder routes for the Inbox Cleaner (copy to
the user's share folder as sender_routes.json). Seed from questionnaire
answers. Each route becomes its own approval cohort. domains match the
sender's email domain; senders match exact addresses; age_floor_days 0
= all ages. never_bulk_domains lists senders the newsletters pass must
NEVER sweep to Deleted Items (file-share / data-room / e-signature
notices) — the matter pass files the ones whose subjects name a deal,
and the rest are left alone. Re-run --analyze after editing.

routes.title: Example newsletter the user wants kept
